title: Extra-Name Bands on Multi-Year Auto-Renewals
content:
**Pricing schedule footnote: SSL/TLS Certificates, auto-renew charges on multi-domain subscriptions**

The extra names of an auto-renew charge that renews a certificate subscription for more than one year are billed in bands for each year renewed. The bands follow the number of extra names the subscription records and the years the auto-renew charge renews, which are the years of the subscription's latest term line (its latest renewal or auto-renew charge line by charge date or, where none has been billed, its purchase line).

| Extra names the subscription records | Auto-renew charge renewing more than one year | Auto-renew charge renewing one year |
|---|---|---|
| 10 or fewer | every extra name at the product's price per added name per year | every extra name at the product's price per added name per year |
| more than 10 but no more than 50 | the first 10 at the product's price per added name per year; the rest at 60 percent of it | every extra name at the product's price per added name per year |
| more than 50 | the first 10 at the product's price per added name per year; those after them up to the 50th at 60 percent of it; those beyond the 50th at 40 percent of it | every extra name at the product's price per added name per year |

The band amounts are per year renewed: the names part for one year is the sum of the band amounts, and the auto-renew charge bills that names part for each year it renews.

**Points at the band edges**

- A subscription recording exactly 10 extra names bills all 10 at the product's price per added name per year; with 11 extra names on a renewal of two or three years, the 11th name is billed at 60 percent.
- A subscription recording exactly 50 extra names on a multi-year renewal bills the first 10 in full and the other 40 at 60 percent; with 51, the 51st name is billed at 40 percent.
- An auto-renew charge renewing one year bills every extra name at the product's price per added name per year, however many names the subscription records.

**Hypothetical illustration (figures chosen for the example only)**

A multi-domain subscription records 63 extra names, its latest term line covers three years, and the product's price per added name per year is taken as 20.00 USD for the illustration. For one year renewed, the first 10 names come to 200.00 USD, the next 40 names at 60 percent of 20.00 USD (12.00 USD each) come to 480.00 USD, and the last 13 names at 40 percent of 20.00 USD (8.00 USD each) come to 104.00 USD. The names part for one year is therefore 784.00 USD, billed for each of the three years renewed. Had the latest term line covered one year, all 63 names would be billed at 20.00 USD, a names part of 1260.00 USD for the year renewed.
